column1: # End-game templates: what a finished suit aims for, per archetype. Edit to match your own goals.
# kind: skill / attr = a cantrip raising that skill or attribute (want = Minor, Major, Epic or Legendary)
# rule (6th column, optional): iftrained = only for characters with that skill trained/specialized;
#       optional = nice to have, not counted in "n of m done". Both: iftrained,optional
# Choices: Impregnability dropped everywhere (nerfed, never a priority); Healing = nice-to-have Legendary on
# melee types when trained; Sneak Attack / Recklessness / Dirty Fighting = Legendary when trained; Tinker/Crafter
# targets are built from the character's own trained tinkering/crafting skills + the attributes that feed them.
# A combined profile (e.g. war+summoning) uses the rows of every part. Ids: see weights.tsv.
# Every profile: a Legendary ward for each damage type (full Legendary coverage is the end goal).
# Melee: Healing, nice to have when trained
